metadata.description: Failure-mechanism-stratified expanded Negative Control database (10 audited + 30 newly curated = 40 negative controls across 6 distinct chemical/process failure mechanisms).

records.name: Ti(Et)4 (Tetraethyltitanium)
records.rationale: Thermally unstable homoleptic sp3 Ti alkyl undergoing rapid beta-hydride elimination.

records.name: ZrMe4 (Tetramethylzirconium)
records.rationale: Pyrophoric, thermally unstable homoleptic sp3 Zr methyl complex.

records.name: CoEt4 (Tetraethylcobalt)
records.rationale: Unstable homoleptic d-block alkyl prone to reductive/beta-H decomposition.

records.name: Hf(Et)4 (Tetraethylhafnium)
records.rationale: Homoleptic sp3 Hf alkyl undergoing facile beta-hydride elimination below vaporization temperature.

records.name: Ta(Me)5 (Pentamethyltantalum)
records.rationale: Explosive/thermally unstable homoleptic sp3 Ta(V) alkyl decomposing rapidly above -20 C.

records.name: Ti(iPr)4 (Tetraisopropyltitanium)
records.rationale: Homoleptic branched sp3 Ti alkyl with 12 beta-hydrogens causing immediate beta-H elimination.

records.name: Ru(Me)4 (Tetramethylruthenium)
records.rationale: Unstable homoleptic late-transition-metal sp3 alkyl prone to reductive ethane elimination.

records.name: WPh5 (Pentaphenyltungsten)
records.rationale: Overcrowded poly-aryl tungsten complex; non-volatile and decomposes prior to sublimation.

records.name: TiPh4 (Tetraphenyltitanium)
records.rationale: Overcrowded poly-aryl Ti(IV) species; thermally decomposes via biphenyl elimination.

records.name: ZrPh4 (Tetraphenylzirconium)
records.rationale: Non-volatile poly-aryl Zr(IV) complex unsuitable for vapor-phase delivery.

records.name: HfPh4 (Tetraphenylhafnium)
records.rationale: High-MW non-volatile poly-aryl Hf(IV) complex decomposing before vaporization.

records.name: TaPh5 (Pentaphenyltantalum)
records.rationale: Sterically congested pentaphenyl Ta(V) complex with negligible vapor pressure.

records.name: CrPh3 (Triphenylchromium)
records.rationale: Air-sensitive poly-aryl Cr(III) species prone to aryl coupling and non-volatile decomposition.

records.name: Ti(OH)4 (Titanium tetrahydroxide sol)
records.rationale: Instantaneous olation/oxolation condensation into polymeric TiO2 gel.

records.name: Zr(OH)4 (Zirconium tetrahydroxide)
records.rationale: Non-volatile hydroxide network undergoing rapid dehydration to ZrO2.

records.name: Hf(OH)4 (Hafnium tetrahydroxide)
records.rationale: Non-volatile hafnium hydroxide sol undergoing irreversible condensation.

records.name: Si(OH)4 (Orthosilicic acid)
records.rationale: Polymerizes spontaneously into amorphous silica gel; non-isolable as a volatile monomer.

records.name: Al(OH)3 (Aluminum trihydroxide)
records.rationale: Insoluble polymeric hydroxide solid with zero ALD/CVD volatility.

records.name: Ta(OH)5 (Tantalum pentahydroxide)
records.rationale: Hydrated tantalic acid gel undergoing rapid polycondensation.

records.name: Sn(OH)4 (Tin tetrahydroxide)
records.rationale: Unstable stannic hydroxide spontaneously dehydrating to SnO2 networks.

records.name: Trichloroacetic acid
records.rationale: Strong corrosive carboxylic acid incompatible with precursor delivery and metal surfaces.

records.name: Trifluoroacetic acid
records.rationale: Strong corrosive fluorinated carboxylic acid causing uncontrolled etching/protonation.

records.name: Acetic acid
records.rationale: Protic carboxylic acid inducing premature hydrolysis/ligand protonolysis rather than clean AS-ALD inhibition.

records.name: Formic acid
records.rationale: Corrosive protic reducing acid incompatible with ALD precursor/inhibitor chemistry.

records.name: Benzoic acid
records.rationale: Solid carboxylic acid lacking selective silanol/metal-oxide ALD passivation stability.

records.name: Oxalic acid
records.rationale: Non-volatile dicarboxylic acid causing corrosive etching and decomposition.

records.name: Pivalic acid
records.rationale: Protic carboxylic acid triggering uncontrolled precursor protonolysis.

records.name: Decane (Non-functionalized alkane)
records.rationale: Zero surface chemisorption or anchoring functional group.

records.name: Hexane
records.rationale: Inert hydrocarbon solvent with no surface-reactive or metal-coordinating center.

records.name: Octane
records.rationale: Inert linear alkane incapable of chemisorption or ALD growth/inhibition.

records.name: Dodecane
records.rationale: Inert long-chain alkane lacking any reactive headgroup.

records.name: Cyclohexane
records.rationale: Inert saturated cycloalkane with zero surface anchoring affinity.

records.name: Adamantane
records.rationale: Inert cage hydrocarbon without functional groups for chemisorption.

records.name: Isooctane (2,2,4-Trimethylpentane)
records.rationale: Branched inert alkane lacking any surface-reactive moiety.

records.name: Silacyclobutadiene
records.rationale: Highly strained anti-aromatic silacycle prone to instantaneous polymerization.

records.name: 1,2-Dichlorodisilane
records.rationale: Pyrophoric chlorodisilane undergoing rapid Si-Si disproportionation.

records.name: Cp2AlH (Bis(cyclopentadienyl)aluminium hydride)
records.rationale: Pyrophoric, oligomerizing organoaluminum hydride.

records.name: Silacyclopropene
records.rationale: Strained 3-membered silirene ring unstable to ring-opening polymerization.

records.name: 1,1,2,2-Tetrachlorodisilane
records.rationale: Unstable chlorodisilane prone to Si-Si disproportionation and HCl evolution.

records.name: Cp2GaH (Bis(cyclopentadienyl)gallium hydride)
records.rationale: Thermally labile organogallium hydride prone to H2 loss and polymerization.
